name: work-panel
description: A right-side Claude Code panel for your task tracker: browse roadmaps, start a ready task, and clear-and-start with a handoff note when you stay in the same roadmap

treeCommand.title: Tracker command
treeCommand.description: Run in the session folder; prints the roadmap tree as JSON (see README). A first word with a slash must exist in that folder; a .py script runs with the folder's .venv python or python3.

startHint.title: First-message hint
startHint.description: Added to the first message of a started task. Empty means 'Use the roadmap skill (work-panel:roadmap).'; a project with its own skill can name it here.

noteAuthor.title: Handoff note author
noteAuthor.description: The author written on handoff notes in the task journal.
